page_notes: Page 213 of PIR², containing the continuation of the entry for C. Arrius Antoninus (PIR² A 1088). The entry starts on the previous page (212) and ends on this page.

problems.issue: Lemma transcription contains 'ARRIVS' instead of 'ARRIUS' (italic 'i' misread as 'v').
Province_text 'Cappadocia' is correct, but province_normalized should be 'Cappadocia' (already correct in registry).
Date range '170-175' is slightly broad; the text specifies 'ante a. 175 vel eo ipso anno t. 11'.
problems.suggested_fix: Adjust date_normalized_start to 173 (t. 9) and date_normalized_end to 175.

problems.issue: Exact_text 'Legatus Aug. pr. pr. Cappadociae' is correct but omits the 'preses (sic) p(rovinciae)' note, which is part of the attestation.
problems.suggested_fix: Include 'preses (sic) p(rovinciae)' in notes or exact_text if possible.

problems.issue: Province_text 'Tres Daciae' is correct, but province_normalized should be 'Tres Daciae' (already correct in registry).
Date range '175-177' is inferred but not explicitly stated. The text says 'post Cappadociam' and references t. 2, 6, 7.
problems.suggested_fix: Clarify in notes that dates are inferred from 'post Cappadociam' and t. references.

problems.issue: Exact_text 'Legatus Aug. pr. pr. co(n)s(ularis) trium Daciarum' is correct but could include the full 't. 2. 6. 7; leg. Aug. pr. pr. t. 4' for completeness.
problems.suggested_fix: Extend exact_text to include 't. 2. 6. 7; leg. Aug. pr. pr. t. 4'.

problems.issue: Normalized_name 'C. Arrius Antoninus' is correct, but displayed_name should match the lemma style: 'C. ARRIUS ANTONINUS'.
Normalized_name 'M. Cornelius Fronto' is correct but not explicitly stated in the text (only 'Cornelius Fronto').
problems.suggested_fix: Add 'M.' to normalized_name if certain, or note uncertainty.

problems.issue: Curator Tifernatium Tiberinorum is marked 'fortasse' (perhaps) in the text, but certainty is set to 'medium'.
problems.suggested_fix: Update certainty to 'low' or add 'fortasse' to notes explicitly.
